title: Arca Titron
extract:
Arca Titron is a  Corpus hammer with high damage, critical chance and status chance, but suffers in attack speed. Kills with the weapon increases the damage of the next Slam Attack while also applying an  Electricity proc.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
This weapon has a #Unique Trait.
Stance polarity  matches  Crushing Ruin.

Acquisition
The Arca Titron's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Unique Trait
All Slam Attacks and stance combo slams inflict a forced  Electricity proc, 1 in the area and multiple with a direct hit.
Kills with the weapon (including DoTs) grant the Slam Capacitor buff, increasing the damage of the next Slam Attack by 250% and its range by 2 meter per charge (max 5 charges).

Unique trait does not affect non-slam attacks.
The slam explosion can kill  Nullifier Crewman Projector Drones, permanently disabling their bubbles.
Damage increase is multiplicative to  Seismic Wave and the Nira's Set bonus, and additive to base damage (e.g.  Pressure Point,  Arcane Fury).
Up to 5 charges can be collected, they have infinite duration and are only consumed on a slam attack.
Kills made with slam attacks do not grant Slam Capacitor charges, even on slams with no charges. However, kills from slam attack DoTs do grant charges.
Damage and range bonuses stack additively with each charge, for a maximum slam damage increase of +1250% and a slam range increase of +10m with 5 charges.
The charge amount can be seen with the electricity charged in the hammer. The current attack range is shown by an energy wave upon slamming.
Melee combos in both Hammer Stance mods have built-in slam attacks which do not consume Slam Capacitor charges but do benefit from them.
Those combo attacks perform true slams with innate 8m range at ground level, which increases to 18m with maximum Slam Capacitor charges.

Notes
Normally this hammer benefits greatly from  Melee Afflictions, even more so with charged Slam Capacitor.
